upstream_spread: spread.json: upstream's own cpu run against its own cuda (bfloat16) run, same fixtures. A GPU backend of the port may not be worse than this spread on any gate, per fixture; a gate below is the CPU-backend limit and also the GPU limit wherever the spread is inside it.

fed_tensors.note: each stage is given its captured input

added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.grouper_int8_features: grouper.feat codes within +-1 of the reference, grouper.fsc scales within one float16 step, grouper.meta max abs error < 0.001

port.note: Slice 4b. The port's PCEN runs through a float32 FFT (pocketfft) like upstream's; no FFT reproduces upstream's MKL rounding noise, which sets PCEN where a channel sits far below its peak (README, Grouper reference). The network is therefore gated in exact-PCEN mode against exact_grouper.py's cpu-exact/ run, checked by the engine's dettato-grouper-test
port.gather: grouper.meta max abs < 1e-3, grouper.feat codes within +-1, grouper.fsc within one float16 step (fed_tensors above), from the captured sub-run maps and taps at the oracle's notes
port.fed_exact_pcen: grouper.probs, grouper.win.probs, grouper.emb, grouper.win.emb max abs < 1e-3 against cpu-exact/, same window layout; the host decode of that prediction puts every note in the same track as cpu-exact/'s groups, with the same instruments
port.from_audio: unchanged (from_audio above, scored by compare.py against cpu/), subject to the exception below

exceptions.status: proposed by the slice 4b author (HOTSTEP-1367), open to challenge in review
exceptions.allowance: the GPU rule: for t1 only, the names spread.json lists under grouping.big_track_name_mismatches or grouper_replay.big_track_name_mismatches
exceptions.measured: CPU backend: the port changes acoustic guitar -> piano and electric guitar -> acoustic guitar; CUDA: names kept
exceptions.why: t1's names hang on single int8 rounding steps of the taps. The port's CPU taps differ from the oracle's in 61 of 2,398,992 int8 codes, each by one step (inside the declared +-1 gather gate; meta within 6.1e-05). Upstream's own grouper (MKL PCEN, the oracle's audio and meta) fed just those taps changes the same two names; fed the port's CUDA taps (72 codes one step off) it keeps them. Which codes land one step off follows from float16 rounding of the transcriber's taps, which the transcriber gate allows at two float16 steps

exceptions.status: proposed by the slice 4b author (HOTSTEP-1367), open to challenge in review
exceptions.allowance: the GPU rule for t1: no lower than spread.json's grouping.same_track_of_oracle (0.707)
exceptions.why: the PCEN filter's float32 FFT (README, Grouper reference): upstream with any FFT but MKL's keeps 0.79 on t1 fed the oracle's own features; with MKL's PCEN the port's CUDA features reproduce the oracle's tracks exactly. The CPU's lower share is the name change above

exception_policy: No looser tolerance preapproved. Report a failing stage and the measured error before proposing an exception.
